units.leftText: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:
units.rightText: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ,

units.leftText: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,
units.rightText: Grace and peace be multiplied to you through the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.

units.leftText: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,
units.rightText: His divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness through the knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and excellence.

units.leftText: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.
units.rightText: Through these He has given us His precious and magnificent promises, so that through them you may become partakers of the divine nature, now that you have escaped the corruption in the world caused by evil desires.

units.leftText: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;
units.rightText: For this very reason, make every effort to add to your faith virtue; and to virtue, knowledge;

units.leftText: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;
units.rightText: and to knowledge, self-control; and to self-control, perseverance; and to perseverance, godliness;

units.leftText: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.
units.rightText: and to godliness, brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness, love.

units.leftText: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: For if you possess these qualities and continue to grow in them, they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

units.leftText: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.
units.rightText: But whoever lacks these traits is nearsighted to the point of blindness, having forgotten that he has been cleansed from his past sins.

units.leftText: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.
units.rightText: Therefore, brothers, strive to make your calling and election sure. For if you practice these things you will never stumble,
leftNotes: 1:10 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

units.leftText: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: and you will receive a lavish reception into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

units.leftText: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.
units.rightText: Therefore I will always remind you of these things, even though you know them and are established in the truth you now have.

units.leftText: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,
units.rightText: I think it is right to refresh your memory as long as I live in the tent of my body,
rightNotes: 1:13 Literally as long as I am in this tent

units.leftText: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.
units.rightText: because I know that this tent will soon be laid aside, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.

units.leftText: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.
units.rightText: And I will make every effort to ensure that after my departure, you will be able to recall these things at all times.

units.leftText: For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
units.rightText: For we did not follow cleverly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of His majesty.

units.leftText: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
units.rightText: For He received honor and glory from God the Father when the voice came to Him from the Majestic Glory, saying, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
rightNotes: 1:17 Matthew 17:5|MAT 17:5*; see also Mark 9:7 and Luke 9:35.

units.leftText: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.
units.rightText: And we ourselves heard this voice from heaven when we were with Him on the holy mountain.

units.leftText: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,
units.rightText: We also have the word of the prophets as confirmed beyond doubt. And you will do well to pay attention to it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.

units.leftText: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.
units.rightText: Above all, you must understand that no prophecy of Scripture comes from one’s own interpretation.

units.leftText: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.
units.rightText: For no such prophecy was ever brought forth by the will of man, but men spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.

units.leftText: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.
units.rightText: Now there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them — bringing swift destruction on themselves.

units.leftText: Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.
units.rightText: Many will follow in their depravity, and because of them the way of truth will be defamed.

units.leftText: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their destruction will not slumber.
units.rightText: In their greed, these false teachers will exploit you with deceptive words. The longstanding verdict against them remains in force, and their destruction does not sleep.

units.leftText: For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;
units.rightText: For if God did not spare the angels when they sinned, but cast them deep into hell, placing them in chains of darkness to be held for judgment;
leftNotes: 2:4 Tartarus is another name for Hell
rightNotes: 2:4 Greek cast them into Tartarus; see the First Book of Enoch (1 Enoch 13:1–11|13:1-11* and 1 Enoch 20:1–4).

units.leftText: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly,
units.rightText: if He did not spare the ancient world when He brought the flood on its ungodly people, but preserved Noah, a preacher of righteousness, among the eight;

units.leftText: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way,
units.rightText: if He condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to destruction, reducing them to ashes as an example of what is coming on the ungodly;
rightNotes: 2:6 WH does not include to destruction.
2:6 Or on future generations of the ungodly

units.leftText: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked
units.rightText: and if He rescued Lot, a righteous man distressed by the depraved conduct of the lawless

units.leftText: (for that righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds),
units.rightText: (for that righteous man, living among them day after day, was tormented in his righteous soul by the lawless deeds he saw and heard )—

units.leftText: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,
units.rightText: if all this is so, then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials and to hold the unrighteous for punishment on the day of judgment.

units.leftText: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries,
units.rightText: Such punishment is specially reserved for those who indulge the corrupt desires of the flesh and despise authority. Bold and self-willed, they are unafraid to slander glorious beings.

units.leftText: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don’t bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord.
units.rightText: Yet not even angels, though greater in strength and power, dare to bring such slanderous charges against them before the Lord.

units.leftText: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,
units.rightText: These men are like irrational animals, creatures of instinct, born to be captured and destroyed. They blaspheme in matters they do not understand, and like such creatures, they too will be destroyed.

units.leftText: receiving the wages of unrighteousness; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and defects, reveling in their deceit while they feast with you;
units.rightText: The harm they will suffer is the wages of their wickedness.

units.leftText: having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin, enticing unsettled souls, having a heart trained in greed, accursed children!
units.rightText: Their eyes are full of adultery; their desire for sin is never satisfied; they seduce the unstable. They are accursed children with hearts trained in greed.

units.leftText: Forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;
units.rightText: They have left the straight way and wandered off to follow the way of Balaam son of Beor, who loved the wages of wickedness.
rightNotes: 2:15 NA, SBL, BYZ, and TR Bosor

units.leftText: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A speechless donkey spoke with a man’s voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.
units.rightText: But he was rebuked for his transgression by a donkey, otherwise without speech, that spoke with a man’s voice and restrained the prophet’s madness.

units.leftText: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.
units.rightText: These men are springs without water and mists driven by a storm. Blackest darkness is reserved for them.

units.leftText: For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who are indeed escaping from those who live in error;
units.rightText: With lofty but empty words, they appeal to the sensual passions of the flesh and entice those who are just escaping from others who live in error.

units.leftText: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.
units.rightText: They promise them freedom, while they themselves are slaves to depravity. For a man is a slave to whatever has mastered him.

units.leftText: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.
units.rightText: If indeed they have escaped the corruption of the world through the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, only to be entangled and overcome by it again, their final condition is worse than it was at first.
rightNotes: 2:20 SBL and WH the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

units.leftText: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.
units.rightText: It would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness than to have known it and then to turn away from the holy commandment passed on to them.

units.leftText: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”
units.rightText: Of them the proverbs are true: “A dog returns to its vomit,” and, “A sow that is washed goes back to her wallowing in the mud.”

units.leftText: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you
units.rightText: Beloved, this is now my second letter to you. Both of them are reminders to stir you to wholesome thinking

units.leftText: that you should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets and the commandment of us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior,
units.rightText: by recalling what was foretold by the holy prophets and commanded by our Lord and Savior through your apostles.

units.leftText: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts
units.rightText: Most importantly, you must understand that in the last days scoffers will come, scoffing and following their own evil desires.

units.leftText: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.”
units.rightText: “Where is the promise of His coming?” they will ask. “Ever since our fathers fell asleep, everything continues as it has from the beginning of creation.”

units.leftText: For they willfully forget that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water by the word of God,
units.rightText: But they deliberately overlook the fact that long ago by God’s word the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and by water,

units.leftText: by which means the world that existed then, being overflowed with water, perished.
units.rightText: through which the world of that time perished in the flood.

units.leftText: But the heavens that exist now and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
units.rightText: And by that same word, the present heavens and earth are reserved for fire, being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

units.leftText: But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
units.rightText: Beloved, do not let this one thing escape your notice: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.

units.leftText: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
units.rightText: The Lord is not slow in keeping His promise as some understand slowness, but is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.

units.leftText: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat; and the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up.
units.rightText: But the Day of the Lord will come like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a roar, the elements will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and its works will be laid bare.
rightNotes: 3:10 Or dissolved; also in verses 11 and 12.
3:10 Or will not be found. BYZ and TR will be burned up; SBL, NE, and WH will be found, i.e., will be unable to hide.

units.leftText: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,
units.rightText: Since everything will be destroyed in this way, what kind of people ought you to be? You ought to conduct yourselves in holiness and godliness

units.leftText: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?
units.rightText: as you anticipate and hasten the coming of the day of God, when the heavens will be destroyed by fire and the elements will melt in the heat.

units.leftText: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.
units.rightText: But in keeping with God’s promise, we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness dwells.

units.leftText: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and blameless in his sight.
units.rightText: Therefore, beloved, as you anticipate these things, make every effort to be found at peace— spotless and blameless in His sight.
rightNotes: 3:14 Or to be found by Him in peace, without spot and without blemish.

units.leftText: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,
units.rightText: Consider also that our Lord’s patience brings salvation, just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote you with the wisdom God gave him.

units.leftText: as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things. In those, there are some things that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unsettled twist, as they also do to the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.
units.rightText: He writes this way in all his letters, speaking in them about such matters. Some parts of his letters are hard to understand, which ignorant and unstable people distort, as they do the rest of the Scriptures, to their own destruction.

units.leftText: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.
units.rightText: Therefore, beloved, since you already know these things, be on your guard so that you will not be carried away by the error of the lawless and fall from your secure standing.

units.leftText: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.
units.rightText: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity.
